claims.statement: PropertyDirectory reads every INI file in its directory and loads it with the filename basename as the property prefix.
PropertyManager parses typed entries beneath INI section groups, prefixes keys when requested, warns for unrecognized values, and treats unreadable configuration as fatal.

WorldObjectBuilder dispatches by the general type property, fills voxel data from data/voxelcluster, configures component slots from properties, and equips the first mountable item in each configured slot.
ClusterCache caches loaded voxel source data by filename and clones voxels when filling a VoxelCluster or WorldObject.
The mox world-object definition identifies a ship voxel cluster and configures mountable shields, weapons, and engines by slots/groups.
